faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

kurzfassung: How the extended family of the victims led the investigation into the Whitehouse Farm murders. Relatives suspected Jeremy Bamber from the beginning and gathered crucial evidence. Their efforts eventually led to his murder conviction and changed the family dynamics forever.
stichpunkte: David Bowflower and other relatives suspected Jeremy Bamber immediately after the 1985 murders.
Police initially treated the case as a murder-suicide committed by Sheila Caffell.
Relatives kept detailed notes, tracked Jeremy's behavior, and searched the crime scene themselves.
David found a missing rifle silencer containing blood traces hidden under the stairs.
Ex-girlfriend Julie Mugford came forward with claims that Jeremy had plotted the killings for money.
Jeremy Bamber was convicted of murdering five family members and sentenced to life in prison.
The family estate eventually passed to the relatives, creating lasting bitter disputes between them.

clips.text: Jeremy rejected rural traditions by skipping young farmers meetings, spending money on nightlife and bohemian friends, and ignoring farm work, which made relatives view him with deep suspicion.
David discovered a hunting rifle silencer hidden inside an ammunition box beneath the stairs at the farmhouse.

clips.hook: An airtight alibi for the hitman
clips.text: Police arrested a local plumber whom Julie claimed had been hired as a hitman, but multiple witnesses confirmed he was in bed elsewhere on the night of the murders.
The jury returned a guilty verdict twenty-one minutes after deliberating, prompting the judge to condemn the defendant for murdering five family members.
British law prevented convicted murderers from inheriting from their victims, so the estate passed directly to the relatives who had worked to put him in prison.

beschreibung:
Heidi visits an unlikely group of detectives: the victims’ extended family. Their sleuthing upended the police’s original theory of the case.
